segments.name: Excess and surplus lines insurance
segments.description: Kinsale writes property and casualty insurance coverages exclusively for hard-to-place excess and surplus lines risks, sold through independent insurance brokers.
segments.evidence: Kinsale is a property and casualty insurance company that focuses exclusively on the excess and surplus lines ("E&S") market in the U.S., where we can use our underwriting expertise to write coverages for hard-to-place risks.

revenueModel.text: Kinsale collects premiums from insureds, primarily small- to medium-sized accounts, for insurance coverages sold through independent insurance brokers, and invests a portion of these funds until claims are paid.
revenueModel.evidence: We collect premiums from our insureds and invest a portion of these funds until claims are paid.
